ENGLISH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1 Extensive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1 Extensive Listening.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1 Extensive Listening.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1 Extensive Listening.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1 Extensive Listening.

2. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. One main idea with supporting sentences
   B. Only one word repeated
   C. Many unrelated topics with no link
   D. No full stops

3. When practising Listening and speaking 2.1.1 Critical Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and speaking 2.1.1 Critical Listening.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and speaking 2.1.1 Critical Listening.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and speaking 2.1.1 Critical Listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and speaking 2.1.1 Critical Listening.

4. When practising Writing 1.5.1 Sentence Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.5.1 Sentence Fluency.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.5.1 Sentence Fluency.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.5.1 Sentence Fluency.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.5.1 Sentence Fluency.

5. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. happiness
   B. run
   C. quickly
   D. blue

6. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. went
   B. goes
   C. going
   D. goed

7. When practising Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes.

8. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. A person, place, thing, or idea
   B. Only a describing word
   C. Only a joining word
   D. Only an action

9. When practising Writing 2.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Spelling, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Spelling.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Spelling.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Spelling.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Spelling.

10. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.2 Conversational Skills: fluency in speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.2 Conversational Skills: fluency in speaking.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.2 Conversational Skills: fluency in speaking.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.2 Conversational Skills: fluency in speaking.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.2 Conversational Skills: fluency in speaking.

11. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.2 Speaking: Etiquette, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.2 Speaking: Etiquette.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.2 Speaking: Etiquette.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.2 Speaking: Etiquette.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.2 Speaking: Etiquette.

12. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library?
   B. Where is the Library
   C. Where is the library
   D. where is the library

13. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading.

14. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Reading Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Reading Fluency.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading Fluency.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Reading Fluency.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading Fluency.

15. When practising Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Verbs Main and Auxiliary Verbs, Tense and Asp, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Verbs Main and Auxiliary Verbs, Tense and Asp.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Verbs Main and Auxiliary Verbs, Tense and Asp.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Verbs Main and Auxiliary Verbs, Tense and Asp.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Verbs Main and Auxiliary Verbs, Tense and Asp.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 3.1.2 Speaking Fluency: Public Speaking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 3.2.1 Extensive Reading: Reference Materials and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Word classes: adjectives, simple prepositions, and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 3.4.1 Paragraphing Skills and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 4.1.1 Selective Listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 4.1.2 Conversational Skills: Speaking Fluency and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 4.2.1 Study Skills: Library Skills and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar in use 4.3.1 Word Classes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Phrases and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 4.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
